This test will check what you have learned in this lesson.
  • Talk about reasons for and results of an action or an event.
  • Report other people's words and thoughts.
  • Talk about unlikely or impossible situations in the present or in the future.
  • Talk about people's beliefs, opinions and personalities.
  • Use colloquial expressions.
